desc:
RUN OR HUNT.

Huss City is a parkour chase across city landmarks. Runners sprint from one safe zone to the other. Hunters carry knives. Get tagged and you become a hunter.

Every crossing, the hunters multiply. Be the last runner standing.

RUNNERS
Wall-run, slide, vault, swing and zipline. Take the rooftops or risk the street. Keep moving to build your Runner's High and outrun everyone.

HUNTERS
Slash up close or throw your knife from range. Cut off routes and work together.

TRAITS
Roll traits for both roles and build around your playstyle.

MORE
• Knives, capes, trails and titles to collect
• Daily rewards and level crates
• Works on PC, mobile and controller

Use code RELEASE for free credits and trait rolls!
Join the group Huss City Holdings for a free cape.
